decisions.reason: The PubMed URL at cp 2424 sits in reason= of {{Update inline|reason=Updated version https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pubmed/34699062|date=...}}, which follows the closing </ref> and is therefore outside any reference; {{Update inline}} is a maintenance template, not a citation template. identifier_link requires the URL to be 'inside a reference or citation template', so it does not apply (the engine's role). textual_mention covers an identifier 'mentioned in text, not as the reference's identifier ... in a parameter that is not an identifier field'; reason= is such a parameter. Raw text is the whole URL (URL row) and key 34699062, both as locked.
